title: Practice 1: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«у-»: уйти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He couldn't bear to be apart from her.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Лодка ___ (отплыть) от берега и вскоре исчезла в тумане.
exercises.prompt: The boat floated away from the shore and soon disappeared into the fog.
exercises.why: «от-»: отплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: доводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: пройти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Haven't you been to the supermarket?
exercises.why: «за-»: заезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tabloids assert that the killer cucumber would have sodomised the mad cow.
exercises.ru: Таблоиды ___, что огурец-убийца совратил бы бешеную корову.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
exercises.why: «при-»: привести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Почувствовав, что дом сотрясается, я ___ (выбежать) наружу.
exercises.prompt: Feeling the house shake, I ran outside.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от-»: отвозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: довезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«про-»: проехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«за-»: заходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

«Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Ancient Carthaginians engaged in child sacrifice.
exercises.why: «при-»: приносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«в-»: входить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«под-»: подходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The ship transports raw materials from Indonesia.
exercises.why: «пере-»: перевозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Над их головами бесшумно ___ (пролететь) большая стая грачей.
exercises.prompt: A great flight of rooks passed silently over their heads.
exercises.why: «про-»: пролететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
